clips.speaker: Joshua Krab
clips.title: Robeco亚太权益主管：AI热潮还有多少空间？关键在于组合多元化

subtitles.en: Yeah, I mean, this is the question that everyone wants to ask, and I think this is, it's really difficult. I often think about when you have an edge in a stock. And two years ago, when these companies were trading at really, really low price to books, I think that was a bit easier.
subtitles.zh: 这是大家都想问的问题，确实很难回答。两年前这些公司市净率极低时，判断起来相对容易。

subtitles.en: At this point, as I sort of said, the valuations or the ratings are very low. The earnings expectations are pretty high, but they've got to come back a long way to not justify those ratings. So I think it's difficult at this point.
subtitles.zh: 目前估值水平较低，但盈利预期很高，需要大幅回落才能让估值显得不合理。所以现在判断难度很大。

subtitles.en: So I think you're either positioned, and I think the real question is, is how much weight or how much risk do you want to allocate to this part of the market? And then you can decide how much you want in physical AI, how much you want in memory, or how much you want in photonics. But I think it's really around that question about how much one leave allocated to this part of the market.
subtitles.zh: 关键在于你愿意给这个板块分配多少权重和风险。然后决定多少配置在实体AI、存储或光子学。核心就是配置比例的问题。

subtitles.en: And I actually think the really important question is here is, what are you doing the rest of your portfolio? Yeah, AI is not working. On the days when it's not working, what else have you got there that's going to provide you some diversification benefit? Because it hasn't mattered for a long time.
subtitles.zh: 真正重要的问题是：组合的其他部分在做什么？当AI表现不佳时，你还有什么能提供多元化收益？因为很久没考虑过这个问题了。

subtitles.en: Yeah, it's a very long 10,000 character position paper and really hitting back again so what China is calling hyped up claims of Chinese overcapacity.
subtitles.zh: 是的，这是一份长达万字的立场文件，再次回击了所谓中国产能过剩的夸大说法。

subtitles.en: So if you look at the data, China's industrial utilization rate was down about 73% in the second quarter. If you can pull up that chart, it is the lowest level since 2020 during the lockdown period.
subtitles.zh: 从数据看，中国二季度工业产能利用率降至约73%，是2020年封锁期以来的最低水平。

subtitles.en: But China is saying that this is not an accurate indicator because different countries, different sectors have different utilization rate.
subtitles.zh: 但中方认为这并非准确指标，因为不同国家、不同行业的利用率各不相同。

subtitles.en: And it's side examples of how the U.S. and EU also run surpluses in areas like pharmaceuticals, like chips and airplanes and it doesn't mean that it's excess capacity, right?
subtitles.zh: 并举例美欧在药品、芯片、飞机等领域也存在顺差，但这并不意味着产能过剩。

subtitles.en: And it's saying that in this case China's trade surpluses is really because of its strong tech advancements, efficient supply chain as well as of course global demand.
subtitles.zh: 文件指出，中国的贸易顺差源于技术进步、高效供应链以及全球需求。

subtitles.en: It also hit back at these accusations of state subsidies saying that China has made attempts to make it more transparent. It's been working with local governments to climb down on improper incentives, for example.
subtitles.zh: 文件还反驳了政府补贴的指控，称中国已努力提高透明度，并与地方政府合作减少不当激励。

subtitles.en: And this is of course coming at a sensitive time because we are running up against that October deadline when the EU and Brussels is supposed to reset their trade ties with China.
subtitles.zh: 这正值敏感时期，因为欧盟将在10月截止日期前重新调整对华贸易关系。

title_lines: 禁售AI机器人和电源逆变器

subtitles.en: So these are things that connect renewable energy sources to power grids and data center equipment.
subtitles.zh: 这些设备用于将可再生能源接入电网和数据中心。

subtitles.en: So the reason in here is to protect national security because the AI-powered robots could potentially surveil Americans, gather data, contribute to foreign intelligence.
subtitles.zh: 理由是保护国家安全，因为AI机器人可能监视美国人、收集数据、为外国情报服务。

subtitles.en: And could potentially even be remotely controlled by external parties.
subtitles.zh: 甚至可能被外部势力远程控制。

subtitles.en: And when it comes to the power inverters, that's also an entry point to install malware that could launch cyber security attacks on large energy systems.
subtitles.zh: 至于电源逆变器，它也是安装恶意软件的入口，可能对大型能源系统发起网络攻击。

subtitles.en: So that's the reason the U.S. is banning them but it applies to new models that are not yet released.
subtitles.zh: 因此美国禁止这些产品，但仅适用于尚未发布的新型号。

subtitles.en: So existing models that are already approved for sale in the U.S.
subtitles.zh: 已获准在美国销售的现有型号不受影响。

subtitles.en: I think this is really about coming into the fundamentals and thinking about the earnings, because the way these are priced, the way these are rated at the moment, is to see a very dramatic fall in earnings, potentially even negative earnings at some point in the cycle.
subtitles.zh: 我认为这实际上要回归基本面，思考盈利情况。因为当前这些资产的定价和评级方式，预示着盈利将大幅下滑，甚至可能在周期某个阶段出现负盈利。

subtitles.en: And how long was that cycle? I mean, how do you map this out? I mean, say it's 2027, some say it's 2030. I mean, how much runway do you think this sort of AI boom has at this moment? Yeah, I mean, this is the question that everyone wants to ask, and I think this is, it's really difficult.
subtitles.zh: 这个周期有多长？如何规划？有人说2027年，有人说2030年。你认为这轮AI热潮还有多少发展空间？这是每个人都想问的问题，确实很难回答。

subtitles.en: I often think about when you have an edge in a stock. And two years ago, when these companies were trading at really, really low price to books, I think that was a bit easier. At this point, as I sort of said, the valuations or the ratings are very low. The earnings expectations are pretty high, but they've got to come back a long way to not justify those ratings.
subtitles.zh: 我经常思考何时在权益资产上具有优势。两年前，这些公司市净率极低，那时更容易判断。目前估值或评级很低，盈利预期很高，但盈利需要大幅回落才能证明当前评级不合理。

subtitles.en: So I think it's difficult at this point. So I think you're either positioned, and I think the real question is, is how much weight or how much risk do you want to allocate to this part of the market? And then you can decide how much you want in physical AI, how much you want in memory, or how much you want in photonics.
subtitles.zh: 所以目前很难。要么你已经布局，真正的问题是：你愿意将多少权重或风险配置到这一市场领域？然后决定多少配置到实体AI、存储或光子学。

subtitles.en: But I think it's really around that question about how much one leave allocated to this part of the market.
subtitles.zh: 但核心问题还是：应该在这一市场领域配置多少。

winning_patterns: 机构/人物权威 + 具体数字/资产 + 强问题，例如 高盛王逸：4-5万亿城市更新会拖住楼市吗
大机构/名人 + 被逼/陷阱/真相/转向 等张力词，例如 野村辜朝明：日本央行被逼到墙角
具体数据 + 政策动作疑问，例如 6月PMI释放积极信号，政府会加码吗
反常识判断 + 下一步条件，例如 低估值可能是价值陷阱，需等待政策转向消费
中国相关议题更容易获得点击，但表达要落在政策、需求、信心、估值、产业升级这些正向框架
外资或海外权威给出对中国更积极的判断时，反差本身就是主标题，不要埋在摘要里
让观众产生单一强反应：居然如此、终于有人说、他说的是真的吗、原来中国优势在这里
大实话角度来自表达者身份与观点反差；言行反差角度必须有公开动作或披露支撑
涉及中国比较优势时，优先把外国企业被迫调整、海外权威改口或中国优势被低估写成冲突
avoid_patterns: 过长的新闻句，尤其是 24 字以上还塞多个从句
只有 策略/机会/影响/前瞻/市场/风险 这类泛词，没有具体对象或张力
美国宏观泛标题如果没有美联储/鲍威尔等强锚点，点击明显弱
纯描述式标题，例如 某市场短期风险与长期催化剂，缺少问题和冲突
经济危机/金融危机/崩盘/崩溃 这类过硬负面财经词
把事实换成疑问号但没有反差，例如 回报路径在哪、未来如何、能否实现
陌生英文人名或机构全称占据第一行，却没有告诉观众这个人为什么值得听
把 Bloomberg LP 等来源或公司法律后缀误当成采访对象
没有公开证据却暗示嘉宾撒谎、操纵或言行不一
